thread:
maya_p: Heads up — onboarding a 13B Llama-derivative (vendor-supplied). We landed weights at s3://redwood-models/llama13b-v2/ but seeing weird tokenizer tokens (non-breaking space bytes) and want a quick RoPE/GQA/MQA compatibility sanity check. Anyone oncall for runtime checks?

alex_w: I can look. Which config are we using? old llama13b.json or the new unified-13b-v2 config?

maya_p: Using unified-13b-v2 as a base. Patch I pushed sets model_path -> s3://redwood-models/llama13b-v2/ and tokenizer -> huggingface/llama-tokenizer-v2. Tokenizer test shows sequences with "\u00A0" -> becomes <0xA0> tokens, causing context-window drift on the eval prompts.

sasha: Important: that vendor pack was quantized with MQA groups (8-bit MQA). Our serving nodes currently assume GQA layouts for the 8-bit loader. If we load MQA weights as GQA we get garbled attention keys. Error shows up as repeating tokens mid-generation.

liam_r: @sasha can you paste the failing log snippet? I pushed a sliding-window KV reuse fix in PR #2487 yesterday which might mask or reveal the issue.

sasha: log: "runtime.cpp:847 ERROR: kv_cache mismatch: expected stride 64, got stride 96" — that stride 96 is typical of MQA group packing.

devex: Quick repro command you can run locally: 
```
./tools/check-model --weights s3://redwood-models/llama13b-v2/ --tokenizer huggingface/llama-tokenizer-v2 --profile rope,gqa,quant
```
It will validate manifest.json, check tokenization spot checks, and verify quant layout header bytes.

maya_p: Thanks. I ran it and got: "tokenizer: ok (minor NBSP)" and "quant-layout: MQA detected; serving-config: default==GQA -> MISMATCH". Also RoPE scaling param alpha is missing from the model card. We default to alpha=1.0 but this model likely needs 1.02 based on weight init notes.

alex_w: Simple mitigation: runtime supports on-the-fly mapping for MQA->GQA if we set NODE_QUANT_ADAPTER=on for the model route. But that's a bit slower. Better long-term: add a loader path that recognizes MQA and uses correct group stride. I'll open a tiny PR.

liam_r: If we enable adapter, watch sliding-window tests. PR #2487 changed KV packing order; there was an edge-case where group stride changes interact with window step causing repeat tokens. I added a unit test but it's limited. Can we run full bench after enabling adapter?

maya_p: I'll enable NODE_QUANT_ADAPTER for the canary route in staging. infra-bot: deploy canary for route redwood/13b-v2-canary with env NODE_QUANT_ADAPTER=1

infra-bot: deploy-bot: started deploy redwood/13b-v2-canary -> staging (sha: b3f7e2). Will report pod logs in ~2m.

alex_w: Also need to set rope_scaling in model config. Suggested snippet for unified-13b-v2.json: 
```
"rope_scaling": "linear",
"rope_alpha": "1.02",
"rope_frequency": "1.0"
```
That fixes subtle positional bias on long eval prompts.

maya_p: Adding that to the patch. One more thing: tokenizer NBSP -> can normalize by pre-tokenize replace: `text = text.replace('\u00A0',' ')` in our input normalization hook. Any objections?

sasha: Fine by me. Add a unit-case to ensure we don't destroy legitimate non-breaking semantics elsewhere — just normalizing for model ingest is OK.

devex: Ping me for a quick code-review on the config PR (cc @alex_w). I can help craft the test for NBSP. :eyes:

alex_w: I'll open PR to add MQA detection -> correct loader branch and add a smoke test for kv_cache stride. Link when ready.

maya_p: Great. Timeline: enable adapter in staging now, run ./tools/check-model, run generating smoke tests and sliding-window perf (30k tokens). If all green I'll request canary prod tomorrow.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: staging pods running. Logs: redwood-13b-v2-canary-0: ok so far, no kv mismatch errors in first 2 minutes.

liam_r: Running bench now. Will paste results in thread when done. If I see repeats I'll revert adapter and grab core dump.

maya_p: Thanks all. Tag me on PRs.
